units: Y. Shek. VIII, 51ᵇ top אילו אמר חוט … ק׳ שלשה וכ׳ if the text (Ex. XXVI, 31) had the word ḥuṭ, it would mean a double thread, if ḳ’liʿah, a triple thread &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 3:2:2">Y. Succ. III, 53ᶜ</cite> bot.; Sifra Emor Par. 12, ch. XVI, v. <cite ref="P00035"><he>עָבוֹת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 6:7">ib. VI, 7</cite>) <he>כמין ק׳</he> he intertwined the limbs of the animals so as to form a network.
Y. Taan. II, 65ᵇ top (in Chald. dict.), v. עַבְיָא.—Trnsf. band, league.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 33:1">Pesik. R. s. 33</cite> (ref. to <he>עבתים</he>, <cite ref="Ezekiel 31:3">Ez. XXXI, 3</cite>) <he>משעה … ק׳ אחת להכעיס וכ׳</he> as soon as the whole world became one league to provoke the Lord, he (Ashur) left their council &c.—Pl. <he>קְלִיעוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Eduyot 3:4">Eduy. III, 4</cite> <he>כל הק׳ וכ׳</he> all networks (woven sheets) are clean &c.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 713">Yalk. Num. 713</cite>, v. <cite ref="S00340"><he>קוֹלְיָינִין</he></cite>.
